Alex Eala Advances in US Open Tennis Tournament

Filipino tennis player Alex Eala has begun her US Open campaign with a decisive victory. She defeated Mary Stoiana in straight sets in the first round. Eala's performance has drawn significant attention, with many fans attending the event to support her. Questions have also been raised about her potential future earnings and career trajectory.
